## About
Lone Star Automotive and Diesel is a family owned auto repair shop serving Boerne, Leon Springs, Scenic Oaks and the surrounding areas. When something doesn't feel or sound right with your car or truck, give us a call. We handle services big and small, from routine maintenance to diesel engine work.
Our customers have given us a 4.9 rating from 566 Google reviews. They often mention Jason, Ray and Nick by name, and how we kept them updated and explained the work along the way.
You'll find us at our Boerne shop on Cascade Cavern, and we also have a second location in Bandera.

## Services
- Diesel engine repair: Repair and performance work on diesel trucks, including heavy duty pickups.
- Gas engine repair: Repair for gas powered cars and trucks.
- Engine diagnostics and performance: Finding out what's really wrong before any work gets done.
- Lube, oil and filter change: Routine oil service to keep your vehicle running well.
- Steering and suspension: Repair for steering and suspension systems.
- Cooling system repair: Repair for your vehicle's cooling system.
- Tire services: Tire work at our Boerne shop.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:30 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: How do I schedule service?
A: Call us or send a service request through our online form, and we'll be in touch within 24 hours to set a time that works for you.

Q: Can I wait while you work on my vehicle?
A: When you request an appointment, you can let us know whether you'd like to wait or leave your vehicle with us.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We serve Boerne, Leon Springs, Scenic Oaks and the surrounding areas.
